runs.message: Make a late-night mix: atmospheric electronic music and trip-hop, a little dark and spacious, no rock or festival EDM.
runs.name: Late-Night Static
runs.reply: Here is a dark, spacious late-night mix built from the library’s atmospheric electronic and trip-hop tracks. I opened with Massive Attack’s ambient remix to set a reverb-heavy, hypnotic tone, then moved through Portishead’s somber half-time groove and Jamie xx’s free-time ambient piece to deepen the darkness. Moby and Morcheeba add wistful, intimate vocals, while Nightmares on Wax and Emancipator keep the Bristol-style warmth and spaciousness. Daft Punk’s “Night Vision” closes with a serene, airy downtempo feel. All selections are low-energy, late-night-tagged, and avoid rock and festival EDM.
runs.guidance: Prefers late-night atmospheric electronic and trip-hop; wants dark, spacious, low-energy textures; explicitly excludes rock and festival EDM.
